name: Nothing But A Heartache in Your Social Life

podcast.body: This track from the "Coke Machine Glow" album was co-written with filmmaker Adam O'Groen. "The track is entitled, Nothing But A Heartache in Your Social Life, Co-written with filmmaker Adam O'Groen."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This track from "Coke Machine Glow" exemplifies the album's quirky style, incorporating spoken word elements and a low-fi recording aesthetic. It was co-written by Canadian film director Adam Goyin. "This is nothing but heartache in your social life. What are you thinking of disappearing? What are you falling off the map? What are you unknown that your feelings in the clearing? When your world's gone flat?"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
